events.title: SolarEdge Technologies' Q1 Loss Wider Than Estimates, Revenues Rise Y/Y
events.body: SEDG posts wider-than-expected Q1 loss as revenues jump 41% y/y and beat estimates, signaling improving operations despite ongoing losses.

events.title: SolarEdge Technologies (SEDG) Reports Q1 Loss, Beats Revenue Estimates
events.body: SolarEdge (SEDG) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -86.96% and +2.33%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
